newsitem.title: PERU: Peru foreign debt $33.47 bln at end of Q3 1996.
newsitem.headline: Peru foreign debt $33.47 bln at end of Q3 1996.

text.p: Peru's total foreign debt obligations rose to $33.47 billion by September 1996, from $32.38 billion in the same month of the previous year, according to latest figures from the Central Bank.
The bank said in a report issued Thursday that the current debt total included $27.86 billion of medium- and long-term debt, and $5.61 billion of short-term debt.
Of the medium- and long-term debt, $25.340 billion corresponds to the public sector, $1.004 billion to the central bank and $1.513 billion to the private sector, the bank said.
Of the short-term debt, $1.955 billion corresponds to the private financial system, $93 million to the central bank and $3.565 billion to "others."
The most recent previous figure for Peru's total foreign debt had been $33.6 billion in June 1996.
